description: The file contains a series of shell script functions and commands used for testing Git hooks and ref handling, specifically related to 'proc-receive' and push operations with mixed references in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes output for readability and stability.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected output in a format for comparison.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares current refs with expected refs.
